# Results — Study 100 (Melting-Ice) on the real total-return tapes

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). One recipe — simulate a 3x
daily-rebalanced ETF from the underlying's daily total return (`L_t = L_{t-1}·(1 + 3·r_t −
fee)`, all-in fee ≈ **5.0%/yr** = 0.95% expense + financing on the 2x borrowed notional),
validate it against the **real** TQQQ / UPRO funds, then compare it to the naive "3x the
period return" line and decompose the gap into the variance-drag and compounding terms.
As-of **2026-06-12**; match the fingerprints to confirm you hold the same tapes. TQQQ
history begins **2010-02-11**, UPRO **2009-06-25** (each fund's inception) — stated
honestly, not back-cast.*

## The simulator reproduces the real funds (it's the identity, not magic)

| Fund | Daily-return corr | RMS tracking err | Final NAV ratio (sim / real) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| **TQQQ** (sim from QQQ) | **0.9989** | 18.6 bps | **0.981** |
| **UPRO** (sim from SPY) | **0.9983** | 19.1 bps | **0.984** |

The constant-leverage daily identity reproduces the real fund almost exactly day-to-day,
and to within ~2% on the 16-year final NAV. The decay mechanic is real and exact.

## Realised 3x vs naive "3x the period return" — full window

| Underlying | Real fund CAGR | Underlying CAGR | Realised 3x final | Naive-3x final | Gap | Verdict |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|
| **QQQ → TQQQ** | **43.9%** | 19.8% | **x368.9** | x55.1 | **+313.8** | compounding **won** |
| **SPY → UPRO** | **32.9%** | 15.1% | **x121.2** | x30.6 | **+90.5** | compounding **won** |

In **both** 2010s tapes the realised 3x NAV ended **far above** the naive line a believer
in "decay" expects. The strong NASDAQ/S&P uptrend made compounding-in-a-trend beat the
variance drag by a wide margin. **"Always decays to zero" is FALSE.**

## The drag-vs-drift decomposition + break-even volatility

| Underlying | 3x drift (k·g) | 3x drag ((k(k−1)/2)·s²) | Net (leading) | Realised vol | **Break-even vol** | Drag dominates? |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--:|
| **QQQ** | 54.2%/yr | 12.8%/yr | +41.4%/yr | 20.6% | **42.5%** | **No** |
| **SPY** | 42.3%/yr | 8.8%/yr | +33.5%/yr | 17.1% | **37.5%** | **No** |

For k=3 the break-even is `s²* = g` (annualised vol ≈ 38–43% here). Both underlyings ran
at ~17–21% realised vol — **well below** the break-even — so drift beat drag. Decay would
have dominated only above ~40% vol.

## Path-dependence laid bare (QQQ underlying, by regime)

| Regime | QQQ return | Realised 3x | Naive-3x | Vol | Drag dominates? |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--:|
| 2010–2021 bull | +922.2% | **+14,566.5%** | +2,766.6% | 20% | No (compounding) |
| 2018 chop | −1.8% | **−23.1%** | −5.5% | 23% | **Yes (decay)** |
| 2022 selloff | −33.2% | −79.3% | −99.7% | 32% | **Yes (decay)** |

The folklore is *right* in chop and selloffs (2018: a −1.8% year cost the 3x sleeve −23%;
2022 was a −79% wipeout) and *wrong* in the trend (the bull market turned 3x into ~53x).
It is **path-dependent**, exactly as Avellaneda-Zhang predict.

## Tradability — the real catch is risk, not a decay law

| Fund | CAGR vs underlying | Sharpe vs underlying | Max drawdown |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| **TQQQ** | **+24.1 pts/yr** | **−0.08** (0.90 vs 0.98) | **−81.7%** |
| **UPRO** | **+17.7 pts/yr** | **−0.09** (0.81 vs 0.91) | **−76.8%** |

The 3x funds earned *far more* than their underlyings — but their **Sharpe is lower** (you
got disproportionately more risk per unit return) and the drawdowns are ruinous (−77% to
−82%, recoverable only by sitting through years of pain). "Hold 3x forever" survived *only*
because the 2010s were an extraordinary trend; it is a leveraged bet on a continued bull,
not a free lunch.

## How to read it

- **"Always decays to zero" → BUSTED.** In both real 2010s tapes the realised 3x NAV ended
  *above* naive-3x; decay is path-dependent, not a law. → 3rd axis **BUSTED**.
- **The drag effect is REAL and exact** (the simulator reproduces the funds at corr 0.999;
  decay genuinely dominates above ~40% vol and in chop/selloffs) — but the *"doomed to
  zero"* framing is wrong. → Signal **REAL** on the mechanism, false on the doom.
- **"Hold 3x forever" → MIRAGE.** Despite +18–24 pts/yr of CAGR, Sharpe is *lower* than the
  underlying and drawdowns reach −82%; the gains are a regime-conditional leveraged beta
  bet with ruinous risk, not durable alpha. → Tradability **MIRAGE**.
